## Step 1 (proved). Filtered CE reduction; no splitting hypothesis

F` is fibrewise `O(4)+O(5)`, so the relative Harder-Narasimhan filtration of `F` over `P^1_B` is canonical: `0 -> L_5 -> F -> L_4 -> 0
` with `L_5`, `L_4` fibrewise `O(5)`, `O(4)`. Dualizing and twisting by `O_{P(E^vee)}(2)` and restricting to `C` yields a canonical\n\n
0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0,   deg W_4 = 20, deg W_5 = 16.\n\nI do **not** assume `W = W_4 + W_5`
globally. Per FND-0097 the splitting is an extra hypothesis: the extension class lies in `Ext^1_{P^1_B}(L_4

that this node must hand downstream. The constraint list independently blocks inferring a global splitting from the fibrewise balanced condition. So the reduction must be filtered.\n\nW
rite `phi: pi_*W -> pi_*(W|_Gamma)` for the CE evaluation map, and `phi_4`, `phi_5` for the induced maps on sub and quotient.\n\n
**(1a) Restriction to `Gamma` stays exact.** `Gamma -> B` is finite, and the sequence is a sequence of vector bundles
on `C`, hence locally split as `O_C`-modules; so `- tensor O_Gamma` preserves exactness, and `p
i_{Gamma *}` is exact because `Gamma -> B` is finite (affine). Hence `0 -> pi_*(W_4|_Gamma) -> pi_*(W|_Gamma) -> pi_*(W_
5|_Gamma) -> 0` is exact.\n\n**(1b) Pushforward along `pi` stays exact.** This is *not* supplied by finiteness of `Gamma` (FND-0099 flags exactly this error

evant constraint line is respected because the module in question is a cokernel that commutes with base change.\n\n**(1d) Snake.** With (1a)

ND-0099 degree vanishings cited explicitly (`deg W_4 = 20 > 10` and `deg W_4(-Gamma) = 14 > 10`).\n\n## Step 2 (proved). Degree bookkeeping and the f
ibrewise failure criterion\n\nOn a geometric fibre, `deg(omega tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) = 10 - 20 + 6 = -4` and `deg(omega tensor W_5^vee
(Gamma)) = 10 - 16 + 6 = 0` (equivalently `4f+n-2g-14` giving `-4` and `0`). A negative-degree line bundle on a smooth projective connected curve has no nonzero section,

so the `f=4` obstruction vanishes identically. A degree-zero line bundle has a nonzero section iff it is trivial — this is effectivity of the vanishing divisor, **not** Serre duality (a recorded constraint war
ns against misattributing it). Rearranging, `H^0(omega tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) != 0` iff `O_C(Gamma) = L := W_5 tensor omega^{-1}`, `

^{-1}) = h^0(M)` with `M := omega^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee` of degree `20-16 = 4`. So `h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M)`. I record expl
icitly (per FND-0083) that `chi(L)=1` proves only that the *full* Abel-Jacobi fibre in `Sym^6` is nonempty; it does **not** prove that the reduced-support open, or the
ordered `Conf_6` incidence, is nonempty on every geometric fibre. That nonemptiness is listed below as an open gap and is used nowhere.\n\n## Step 3 (proved). Univers
al determinantal lemma on Pic^0\n\nLet `S` be locally Noetherian, `C/S` smooth projective genus `g`

and `Fit_0(coker Phi)` vanishes on `e(S)`.\n\nThe intrinsic derivative of a determinantal map at a rank-drop point is a well-defined map `T
_e Pic^0 -> Hom(ker, coker)`, i.e. `H^1(O_C) -> Hom(H^0(omega), H^1(omega))`. Deforming `Poin` by `
xi in H^1(O_C)` moves the section by cup product with `xi`, so the intrinsic derivative is exactly the cup-product pairing `H^1(O) x H^0(omega) -> H^1(om

is an isomorphism.\n\nBy the standard first-order description of a `1`-generic maximal-
minor degeneracy locus, the maximal minors of `Phi` generate, modulo `I_e^2`, exactly the image of the (dual of the) intrinsic derivative inside `I
_e/I_e^2`. Isomorphy of the intrinsic derivative gives spanning of `(I_e/I_e^2) tensor k(e)`; Nakayama over the local
ring at `e` (using that `Pic^0` is smooth over `S` and `e` a section, so `I_e/I_e^2` is locally free of rank `g` on `e(S)`) upgrades spanning to generation of

` follows from the Fitting base-change computation `Fit_0(coker(e^* Phi)) = 0` (rank drop at `e`), not from a radical/support argument — again

as the constraint requires.

Hence `Fit_0(coker Phi) = I_e` as ideals.

`deg(omega tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) = 0` in Step 2.

## Step 5 (proved, stack-level). Ordering

Over the reduced-support open of the relative degree-six effective-divisor space, `S_6` acts fre
ely on ordered pairwise-distinct sections, so `Conf_6 -> (reduced-support open)` is a finite etale `S_6`-torsor **on the stack of pairwise-distinct sections**.
Per FND-0075 this fails on coarse moduli at curves whose automorphisms permute marked points, and per FND-0087 reduction must be applied compatibly to both sides (
`I_red -> (I^{red-supp})_red`), never to the source only —
reducing only the source destroys flatness over nonreduced bases. The reduced-support locus is open and **not** closed (complement of a finite closed image, inside a fibrewise irreducible `Sym^6`

containing non-reduced divisors such as `6p`).
